build_sparse_vgg_model: build a sparse VGG network with convolutional and max-pooling layers using scn.SparseVggNet
create_input_layer: create an InputLayer to encode sparse tensor locations and features into a SparseConvNetTensor
create_bl_input_layer: create a BLInputLayer with batched sparse inputs using scn.prepare_BLInput for mini-batch processing
run_sparse_conv_model: run a sparse convolutional model with SubmanifoldConvolution, BatchNormReLU, and SparseToDense layers
build_sequential_model: build a Sequential model by chaining SparseVggNet, convolution, batch norm, and SparseToDense modules
